person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Charles Coussoule in Box 149 with a short private identifier. The Army merged file contains one exact-name row dated 3 November 1942, and U.S. Army special-operations history directly identifies the rare exact name in OSS. A separate Box 140 Captain Charles Conssoule entity remains unmerged, so the Box 149 file must establish whether the rows are duplicate or cross-reference entries.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Compare Boxes 140 and 149 and resolve the short private identifier before linking, merging or transferring the officer classification.
